name: Eldervire
summary:
Eldervire is a true MMORPG inspired by classic-old school adventure games. (Currently pre-alpha) Explore open world, train 14 different skills, world bosses, raids, PvP in various different ways and build your character from beginner to legend.

With simple click-to-move gameplay, nostalgic visuals, player trading, banking, shops, bosses, treasure chests, Elder maps and a growing world full of NPCs and secrets, Eldervire is built for players who love progression, discovery, and the grind of a true classic MMO.
